name: eROSITA
full_name: extended ROentgen Survey with an Imaging Telescope Array
summary: German-led SRG soft-X-ray survey instrument whose data support sterile-neutrino / ALP decay-line searches and dark-matter structure studies.
detection_principle: Grazing-incidence X-ray mirrors and CCD detectors record sky positions and energy spectra to search for narrow lines or diffuse radiation.

status.label: Partly operating, with further construction continuing
status.evidence: Data taking paused in safe mode from 2022-02; existing data are still released and analyzed in 2026. The mixed status denotes suspended hardware observations alongside continuing scientific analysis.

collaboration.name: eROSITA collaboration / mission team

key_parameters.name: Representative dark-matter mass range
key_parameters.value: 2–18 keV in the 2026 Large Magellanic Cloud analysis

phases.name: Sky observations
phases.description: Safe mode in 2022; continued non-operation is supported by a 2026 institutional announcement

phases.name: Data releases and analysis
phases.description: Continuing use of previously collected data

results.summary: The Large Magellanic Cloud line search found no dark-matter signal, setting lifetime and coupling constraints.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
